hints.title: Examine All Substrings
hints.text: Since the length of s is at most 1000, iterate over all possible starting positions.

hints.title: Maintain Running Digit Counts
hints.text: As the substring extends, maintain the counts of each of the 10 digits and track the distinct digit count and maximum frequency.

hints.title: Check Uniform Frequency
hints.text: All present digits have equal frequency if and only if distinct_digits * max_freq equals the substring length.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all substrings with independent frequency hashing takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling frequency counts allow constant time verification per expansion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verify equal frequency via distinct_count * max_count == length.
